criteria.criterion: AC1: Phase-change only reaches relevant project
criteria.name: AC1: Phase-change only reaches relevant project
criteria.notes: server.ts broadcastToProject() helper filters wss.clients by ws.projectRoot === event.projectRoot. When a client connects with ?project= query param, it only receives phase-change events for that project. Clients without the param receive all events (backwards compat). Container-state and container-log broadcasts use the same filter.
criteria.evidence: server.ts lines 22-32: ProjectWebSocket interface; lines 26-31: broadcastToProject helper; lines 55-58: phase-change listener; lines 63-67: container-state listener; lines 71-75: container-log listener

criteria.criterion: AC2: Container-state only reaches relevant project
criteria.name: AC2: Container-state only reaches relevant project
criteria.notes: Container-state events already include projectRoot in their payload. The broadcastToProject helper now filters by matching projectRoot. Verified in server.ts line 65-67.
criteria.evidence: server.ts line 65: broadcastToProject(data, msg) replaces the unconditional for-loop broadcast

criteria.criterion: AC3: Container-log only reaches relevant project
criteria.name: AC3: Container-log only reaches relevant project
criteria.notes: Container-log events already include projectRoot. Same filter applies. Verified in server.ts line 73-75.

criteria.criterion: AC4: Clients without project param receive all events (backwards compatible)
criteria.name: AC4: Clients without project param receive all events (backwards compatible)
criteria.notes: broadcastToProject logic: if (!pws.projectRoot || !eventProject || pws.projectRoot === eventProject). When eventProject is undefined (old events without projectRoot), all clients receive it. When pws.projectRoot is undefined (client connected without ?project=), all events reach that client.

criteria.criterion: AC5: Client reconnecting after project switch receives correct events
criteria.name: AC5: Client reconnecting after project switch receives correct events
criteria.notes: WebSocket connection is recreated on project change since the URL changes (?project=newPath). The old connection is closed via useEffect cleanup. Verified in use-websocket.ts: the resolvedUrl includes the project param, so reconnecting with a different project uses a new URL.

criteria.criterion: AC6: Agent event streaming is unaffected
criteria.name: AC6: Agent event streaming is unaffected
criteria.notes: Agent events use per-connection handlers (not broadcastToProject). The per-connection agentHandler and terminalHandler are unchanged. Only the phase-change, container-state, and container-log broadcast loops were modified.
criteria.evidence: server.ts lines 34-51: agentHandler and terminalHandler are unchanged
